email.description: Who it's for; only this address can use it. None for a link anyone can use once.

name.description: Their name, to fill in the sign-up form.

link.description: The link to send: the web app's invitation page.

createdBy.description: The name of the admin who made it.

usedBy.description: The name of the account made with it.

emailedAt.description: When it was emailed, if it was.

plan.description: The plan the account joins (PLAN-5); the default (or the sign-up trial) when there's none.

planDays.description: For how many days, then the default plan; none: it doesn't end.

description: An invitation to make an account, even when sign-up is closed (USR-3). It works once, for 14 days.
